RoA_GLOBAL_UNITS_010.en: Activate to take only <Amdf,DataH1,%>% of the damage from Magic attacks and no damage from Piercing attacks, but have <Amdf,DataC1,%>% reduced movement speed.

RoA_GLOBAL_UNITS_012.en: Deactivate to move at normal speed, but take full damage from spells and piercing attacks.
